title: Numerical study of methanol steam reactor based on field synergy principle and analysis of different operating conditions
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,1729-1744
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01718H, Paper
Shuntao Li, Chao Wang, Mingzheng Liao, Yanping Du, Jiming Gao, Yanbing Wu
The geometry of the tube dictates the gas separation point, shaping shell-side flow and temperature distributions. Circular tubes create an expanded gas wake that optimizes temperature–velocity synergy and enhances heat transfer efficiency.
